Atlas docs sentinel

Documentation your customers can actually find.

Atlas is the Lighthouse documentation site. It publishes guides for the Harbor web app and the Lantern API from Markdown in the same repo your team already works in, with fast search and versioned releases.

GuidesAuthor pages in Markdown and preview them on a branch before they ever reach a reader.
SearchInstant full-text search with zero-result reporting so gaps in your docs surface on their own.
VersioningPin docs to each release so customers always read the guide that matches the API they call.
